Name: Extra Designs
Author: Shaduth
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1Zi6Rmp.png[/img]﻿
This mod adds new and improved variants of buildings and content in Stardew Valley. This mod will provide many options for you to retexture the content. It may not add any new content of its own, but it does change and vary the already existing content. You can customise your playthrough however you wish with the multiple different retextures that are provided by this mod. Simply look at the image that is paired with the .xnb file and replace the original .xnb with that one. Then once you load into the game, you should see the changes straight away.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YJ4Y6gN.png[/img]
If you have any issues or queries or even suggestions, please feel free to contact me and I'll be happy to reply.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vBbmmYq.png[/img]
We have a Discord of which will involve you in a community of likeness and you'll get access to sneak peeks and additional content - [url=https://discord.gg/TJ2w2NP]https://discord.gg/TJ2w2NP[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PEi6czp.png[/img]
If you're feeling generous, I have a [url=https://www.patreon.com/ExtraMods?fan_landing=true]Patreon[/url] and a [url=http://paypal.me/ExtraMods]PayPal[/url] account, feel free to donate if you wish, it really does help as it allows me to upgrade software so I can delve into deeper and more complex features.
